name: Las Casas
source:
Leader of the Dylas-Leen's Air Guild.
He entrusted the Ulumensh to Connie and does everything he can to protect the guild's members.
He seems to have ties with many of the great scholars of the empire.
[spoiler]He's the son of the 8th of the Ten Peerless Scholars, Las Casas "The Priest"[/spoiler]
